name: core_List_apply_maxOn_lt_iff
statement: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : LE β] [inst_1 : DecidableLE β] [inst_2 : LT β] [Std.IsLinearPreorder β] [Std.LawfulOrderLT β] {xs : List α} {f : α → β} (h : xs ≠ []) {b : β}, f (List.maxOn f xs h) < b ↔ ∀ (x : α), x ∈ xs → f x < b

name: core_List_decide_mem_cons

name: core_List_filterMapM_loop_eq
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : α → m (Option β)} {l : List α} {acc : List β}, List.filterMapM.loop f l acc = (fun x => acc.reverse ++ x) <$> List.filterMapM.loop f l []

statement: ∀ {n : Nat}, List.finRange (n + 1) = 0 :: List.map Fin.succ (List.finRange n)

name: core_List_flatMapM_loop_induct_unfolding
statement: ∀ {m : Type u → Type v} [inst : Monad m] {α : Type w} {β : Type u} (f : α → m (List β)) (motive : List α → List (List β) → m (List β) → Prop), (∀ (bs : List (List β)), motive [] bs (pure bs.reverse.flatten)) → (∀ (a : α) (as : List α) (bs : List (List β)), (∀ (bs' : List β), motive as (bs' :: bs) (List.flatMapM.loop f as (bs' :: bs))) → motive (a :: as) bs do let bs' ← f a List.flatMapM.loop f as (bs' :: bs)) → ∀ (x : List α) (x_1 : List (List β)), motive x x_1 (List.flatMapM.loop f x x_1)

name: core_List_flatMapM_wfParam
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {xs : List α} {f : α → m (List β)}, List.flatMapM f (wfParam xs) = List.flatMapM f xs.attach.unattach

name: core_List_foldrM_filterMap
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} {γ : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : α → Option β} {g : β → γ → m γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldrM g init (List.filterMap f l) = List.foldrM (fun x y => match f x with | some b => g b y | none => pure y) init l

name: core_List_foldrRecOn_cons
statement: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {b : β} {x : α} {l : List α} {motive : β → Sort u_3} {op : α → β → β} (hb : motive b) (hl : (b : β) → motive b → (a : α) → a ∈ x :: l → motive (op a b)), List.foldrRecOn (x :: l) op hb hl = hl (List.foldr op b l) (List.foldrRecOn l op hb fun b c a m => hl b c a ⋯) x ⋯
